questions.question: If a sore looked deeper than the skin and its hair had turned white, what did God's law say the priest declares?

answers.text: The person may go home to rest
The person must wash in the river

questions.question: In God's law for skin diseases, what did the priest declare if the disease covered the whole body and turned white?

answers.text: The person must burn his clothes
The person must offer a sacrifice

questions.question: Under God's law, where did a person with a skin disease have to live as long as the infection lasted?
If harmful mildew spread in a wool, linen or leather item, what did God's law say must happen to it?

answers.text: It is buried outside the camp
It is kept by the priest
